parent_title: First-place readiness — adaptive banking builder, kit v3

tasks.title: Pin kit and protect repository
acceptance: Record kit v3 and source precedence.
Review tracked source notes and use an explicit submission allowlist.
Exclude credentials, kickoff email, archives, caches and raw generated evidence.

tasks.title: Reproducible runtime
acceptance: Python 3.11 setup is reproducible for the active builder environment.
The active Codex CLI session can authenticate; no collaborator identity or second-computer verification is required.
Generation-only isolation is tested with benign forbidden-path sentinels; record tool/context exposure.

tasks.title: Staging deployment adapter
acceptance: Persistent slots validate, save, publish, read back and export.
Keep event model and browser-like User-Agent.
Record published version; reject material platform field stripping; bound every API wait.

tasks.title: Policy contract and provenance
acceptance: Extract objectives, actions, identity, calendars, amounts, attempts and outcomes with source evidence.
Compose base/overlay and resolve applicable amendments.
Changed policy and schema values require no builder-source edits.

tasks.title: Fresh builder controller
acceptance: Support repeated --brief and explicit --tool-api.
Generate policy/workflow through isolated Codex stdin; credentials stay in controller.
Enforce 30-minute deadline and reserve export time; emit sanitized required trace.

tasks.title: Deterministic policy helpers
acceptance: Integer cents, deadlines, holidays, relative weekdays and supplied now pass boundary checks.
Identity counters preserve successful factors and ignore allowed hints.
Stable product IDs, per-product attempts and confirmed commitments are enforced.

tasks.title: Adaptive workflow generation
acceptance: Generate routes/extraction/dialogue and code from goal, policy and current schema.
Resolve fields and enum values from OpenAPI, with no case-ID shortcuts.
Compile different supported banking goals; every executable path terminates safely.

tasks.title: Irreversible-action handling
acceptance: Write only confirmed final terms; never duplicate a recorded promise.
Stage notes until non-transfer close; discard pending notes and unwritten commitments on transfer.
Keep successful promises after partial failure; close exactly once.

tasks.title: Structural and semantic validation
acceptance: Reject nulls, invalid paths, unsafe code, unresolved required bindings and forbidden URLs.
Check response mapping, passthrough fallbacks, factor ordering and final-close discipline.
Report unproven dialogue behavior as requiring hosted evidence.

tasks.title: Local development fixtures
acceptance: Author 36 training and 24 validation fixtures with independent policy-bound oracles.
Cover raw/clean equivalence, schema changes, calendars, amounts and state invariants.
Do not claim local deterministic checks prove real dialogue behavior.

tasks.title: Hosted runner adapter
acceptance: Use unique fixture_id and known bank_case_id without dictionary collisions.
Start fresh sessions per fixture and repetition; preserve server seed facts.
Bound polling, page all results, attribute versions and coordinate one simulation lease.

tasks.title: Hosted development scenarios
acceptance: Audit the first 60 training/validation variants against their official seeds.
Cover fragments, corrections, questions, digressions, worded values and compound attacks.
Persona behavior and oracle must agree; security questions must not silently change expected outcomes.

tasks.title: Stronger scoring and evidence
acceptance: Compare exact ledger multisets and enforce ordering, counters, duplicate-write and transfer-note checks.
Capture transcripts, call/run IDs, judge verdict, latency and preserved retries.
Missing/incomplete evidence is not a pass; separate local and hosted claims.

tasks.title: Bounded autonomous repair
acceptance: Repair from input rules and sanitized violation explanations, not customer IDs/expected-value shortcuts.
Republish and inspect each candidate; reserve time to export.
Retain failed/incomplete attempts and original infrastructure evidence.

tasks.title: Development evaluation
acceptance: Compare baseline and structured builder on training then validation.
After authorization, run actual hosted cases and check regressions.
Prioritize strict pass rate and zero policy/security failures before amount/speed.

tasks.title: Fresh held-out evaluation
acceptance: Freeze a candidate, then author 60 new local and 60 hosted holdouts.
Score policy/schema adaptation separately from wording robustness.
Consume holdout if used for repair; require a fresh set for new blind claims.

tasks.title: Final rehearsal and freeze
acceptance: Reproduce exact builder from clean checkout with fresh policy/schema inputs.
Verify traces, publication/export agreement, allowed model/tools and <30-minute build.
Record commit/config/model and critical cases passing all 3 repetitions.

tasks.title: Hidden builds and submission package
acceptance: Run two hidden inputs without manual workflow edits or source/prompt rule additions.
Produce two exports, selected build traces, commit and submission manifest.
Finish broad tests before 20:00 Istanbul; preserve a 22:45-23:00 submission buffer.

active_work.description: Demir continues alone. Collaborator names, separate computers, account ownership attestations and timed handoffs are not prerequisites. Assignments are coordination metadata; GitHub permissions govern writes.
